procedure_file: extraction_procedure_social_addendum_v1.4_social science Classes 6-10 on top of procedure v2.md

second_method.method: printed BLUE PRINT difficulty table total (Easy 14 + Average 4 + Difficulty 2 = 20), pdf 41; independently, the answer side's keys counted

count_gate.note: Question side labels 1-20 monotonic, no gaps, no duplicates (I 1-5, II 6-8, III 9-13, IV 14-16, V 17-20); answer side keys 1-20 in order (keys 17-20 at the top of pdf 112, above the Unit 11 heading). BLUE PRINT 14/4/2 = 20 = audited count. Difficulty per question: easy 0, average 0, difficult 0, untagged 20.

method_notes: Pages: Q pdf 41 (heading 'Unit -10', LO 12, BLUE PRINT, q1-4) 42 (q5-15) 43 (q16-20). A side 'Key Answers: Unit 10. Our sense organs' pdf 111 (keys 1-16), pdf 112 top (17-20). Folios = pdf page.
BILINGUAL: all Kannada dropped (Unicode both sides). q18 stem prints a stray combining mark at the end (font artefact) — removed from text, kept in text_as_printed.

Sections: s1 I match q1-5 (numbered rows -> one-pair match questions); s2 II 'Name the organ …' q6-8 (q7, q8 print a blank -> fill; q6 prints none on its English line -> vsa; text = instruction + situation); s3 III T/F q9-13; s4 IV q14-16 (q14 one printed line -> vsa; q15 five 'organ – function' lines -> la, 5 steps; q16 two sentences -> sa); s5 V fill q17-20.
MARKS (R-E9, control rev 3): every header's N equals its printed count -> s1 1, s2 1, s3 1, s4 2, s5 1 (section_header).

DIFFICULTY: none printed -> null + 'no difficulty tag'. quota_table difficulty_only; second method = BLUE PRINT total 20 (agrees). LO (R-E10): lesson LO 12 (its row also names the teeth LO text), lo_source 'lesson_table'.

TOPICS (R-E7): map v1 evs-3-10 = s00 (Introduction, not tickable) + s01 Eyes, s02 Ears, s03 Nose, s04 Tongue, s05 Skin. Each question tagged to the organ section its content names, topic_source 'content', confidence 'high' (16 q); questions about all five senses (q14-17) carry all five tickable sections with 'low' per R-E7 (one clear section required for 'high'). s00 never tagged.

KEYS — SOURCE DEFECT IN SECTION I: the English match keys '1.To learn the word 2.To smell 3.To taste 4.To feel 5..Skin' do not follow their own Kannada lines (seeing / knowing sound / identifying smell / tasting / knowing touch) — the English column looks displaced by one row. Stored exactly as printed: q1-q4 'printed key contradicts fact' (review-blocking), q5 'match key value not among column-B items'. Not a numbering shift (labels 1-5 align on both sides).
Other keys: II '6.Skin 7.,Ear 8. Nose'; T/F 9 F, 10 T, 11 F, 12 T, 13 F; q14 'Five 1. Eyes, 2.. Ears, …' one line verbatim.
